items.difficulty_reason: Both parts are fully written out: replace the covering stacks by schemes via smooth coverings, take the disjoint union f to get a smooth (resp. flat lfp) surjection, lift an arbitrary object x along an etale (resp. fppf) covering so that x_i^*F = u_i^*f^*F is quasi-coherent, conclude x^*F is quasi-coherent by the local-final-object lemma, and finish with the characterization lemmas of quasi-coherent modules on stacks.
